_readme: Single source of truth for business facts. Change a number HERE first, then propagate to the site and run `npm run check` — the verifier fails until every page agrees. See .agent/HARNESS.md.

external._note: Third-party amounts the site quotes. Money belongs in `fees` — the verifier treats every value there as a dollar amount a page is allowed to print.

brand.note: Decision 5 (2026-08-04): 'Mary' appears only on about.html. Everywhere else the brand voice is 'our drivers' / 'our team'.
